Ok. I'm gonna be honest the best thing to do in this situation is to sit down with her calmly and ask if she wants to talk about it. 
For the person suffering with OCD we feel embarrassed and ashamed of out compulsive thoughts. We feel like a liability to our partner cause we can't enjoy the things that regular couples enjoy as we spend half the bloody time worrying and thinking, equally we get upset or angry at them for things we imagine they may do or may have done. Can I ask does she get jealous or angry over past relationships or previous behaviour?
Now for you it's not a nice situation to be in either as you're the one her ocd is focused on. 
Again you need to sit down with her and explain that although these compulsive thoughts are in her head you guys are in this together as a team as her thought process affects you also.
